summary.intent: Land a fix for the michi-pipeline scheduler so steps that never ran (cancelled, window ended, breaker open, start not recorded) report no start time, then review the subagent's work and open a PR.
summary.outcome: A subagent pushed branch fix/pipeline-start-record with the fix, docs, and four new tests. The main session reviewed the diff, ran just check and just test (1,228 Rust and 186 Node tests passing), confirmed a mutant was caught by the tests, committed a changeset fix, pushed, and opened the PR.

repo: michi-pipeline StepRecord started_at/elapsed are now None whenever a step's own code was never invoked, tracked by a per-step `invoked` flag set right after the breaker admits the step.
Job::group_deadline changed from a (Instant, String) pair to a GroupDeadline { end, key, length } struct so both deadline paths can share deadline_passed_outcome.
Pre-commit and pre-push hooks run moon format-check and lint-affected clippy across all crates.
Changesets live in .changeset/ with a format like `michi-pipeline: patch`.
Spec docs live in docs/spec/ (e.g. 08-pipeline-execution.md) and should be updated alongside behavior changes.

record_start is a blocking call that cannot be aborted: after cancel, execute/resume still wait for in-flight record_starts, so a hung save blocks the run; callers should give the save its own timeout.

code.finding: step_finished writes started_at/elapsed only when the `invoked` flag is set; previously it only checked NotRun(StartNotRecorded). Scheduler::deadline_passed and the post-save check in run_step now share deadline_passed_outcome.
record_start docs corrected: drive loops until the JoinSet is empty, so cancellation does not abort a blocking save.
Added four tests, including a positive control (a_step_that_ran_after_its_save_has_a_start_time) so a fix that drops timing for all steps also fails.

workflow: Mutation testing (reverting the fix or flipping the flag and checking tests fail) is an effective way to verify new race tests actually guard the behavior.
The main session independently re-ran checks and a mutant rather than trusting the subagent's report.
Pushing through hooks may need to run outside the sandbox, since moon needs to write .git/config.

friction: just fmt-check fails inside the sandbox because moon can't write .git/config; commits had to run outside the sandbox.
The oxfmt markdown format check could not run because the sandbox blocked the npm registry download.
A local branch fix/pipeline-start-record already existed at origin/main and was reused.
The subagent's changeset needed a fix, which the main session rewrote and committed.
open_items: just check was only partly verified by the subagent: deny, typos, rustdoc and the markdown format check were not run by it.
The subagent widened the scope: open-breaker and pre-save cancel cases now also drop started_at in non-durable runs. This could be reverted if the change should be limited to durable paths.
A hung record_start can still stall a cancelled run; the docs recommend a caller-side timeout but no enforcement was added.
